name: clearly
description: Clearly — your workspace as a filesystem, plus a spatial canvas, over MCP.

plugins.name: clearly
plugins.description: Mount your Clearly workspace as a filesystem your agent can ls, grep, read and edit — documents, projects and tickets, with every change versioned and revertable, and a status call that says what the human changed since you last looked. Adds a spatial canvas for diagrams and diffs, and design skills that hold the agent to studio craft.
